_readme: Signature-keyed CSS class registry for books/epub.css. When processing a new book: parse its CSS, compute a normalized 'prop:value' signature per class (sorted, later-prop-wins), and look it up here before minting a new code. Reuse the code if the signature matches; otherwise append a new entry with the next base-26 code (a..z, aa..az, ...) and add the rule to epub.css.
